company.name: Bodyport
company.shortDescription: Bodyport develops remote cardiovascular monitoring technology to help detect and manage heart failure and other chronic conditions.
company.description: Bodyport is redefining how heart failure is managed by making early, in-home detection of congestion possible with a single step. Our solution combines the Bodyport Cardiac Scale, which non-invasively measures key hemodynamic biomarkers, with the Congestion Index, an advanced algorithm that accurately predicts worsening heart failure before symptoms escalate. These insights flow into a connected software platform that delivers timely alerts and actionable interventions to patients and care teams. Together, these tools enable earlier treatment, prevent avoidable hospitalizations, and empower people to live healthier, more stable lives.

productsAndServices.description: A noninvasive scale that measures hemodynamic biomarkers through the feet to assess heart function and fluid status.
productsAndServices.name: Bodyport Cardiac Scale

aiResearchSummary.text: Bodyport is researching and developing a cardiovascular monitoring platform that receives signals from a measurement device to extract measurements for multiple biomarkers. The technology, described in Predicting worsening heart failure using intermittent noninvasive biomarker, focuses on predicting worsening heart failure by analyzing noninvasive biomarker data collected intermittently. This highlights Bodyport’s focus on home-based cardiovascular health monitoring and early detection of heart failure risk.
